title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content: 小村还是那个小村，小河静静的流淌，白云静静的飘荡，小草静静的生长，所以，小村还是那个静静的小村，改变着静静的一切是这群无忧无虑的乡村孩子们。佳小夜正和一大帮孩子们在小河里玩耍，孩子们都是十岁上下，摸鱼捉虾，玩泥撩水。一个个玩的兴高采烈，太阳晒得花儿、草儿低头，猫儿、狗儿晒得…不知道跑哪里去了。水真凉啊！舒服啊！真的好痛快！孩子们的眼睛里，这日子不就应该是这样子的吗？需要感慨吗？岸上，有一麻衣中年人，冷冷的看着这群孩子们，半晌，轻叹一声，一闪身，不见了。一个时辰后，孩子们累了，一个一个爬上岸边，各回各家，各找各妈…佳小夜12岁了，不小了……他父母都不是这村里的。母亲？他从来没见过，只看到过画像，不像是乡下人。父亲嘛，6岁前见过，没啥印象！现在知道是大城市里的富豪、有钱人。小夜6岁多被舅舅带到这个小村庄，现在过去了6年，所以，佳小夜12岁了…小夜轻手轻脚的走向家里，刚进院门，看到屋檐下的舅舅，正是刚刚在河边的麻衣中年人。“你现在去做功课，饭过后，来舅舅书房一趟”“哦”佳小夜进入自己的房间，摆上笔墨纸砚，先练手了3页楷字，又画了几张画，才拿起书，认真背诵、阅读。书卷都是些常见的儿童启蒙课程，主要是每个字的理解，这是小夜舅舅的主要要求。认字，练字，理解，还有每句话的意思以及自己的见解，一会儿舅舅要考查，马虎不得。一个时辰后，小夜又换了一本书---《草药百科真解》，此书舅舅要求死记硬背，不求甚解。记的前几个月他看的是《金石名录》，舅舅也是这样要求他的，小夜没在意，考查时他将天阴石和泓阴石混淆了，结果手掌肿了3天，打的他钻心的疼，唉！还不让吃饭…黄昏，下人丫鬟端了饭食，轻手轻脚的退出门了，小夜细嚼慢咽的吃完晚饭，净手，整理一下衣服，出门了。穿过简陋的鹅卵石小径，越过厢房，来到舅舅书房，吸了口气，刚要扣门，“进来吧”，舅舅说到，小夜进门行礼问安，接着就是考究学问，还好，今天舅舅问题不难，小夜一一回答，随后，有几个不明白的字，词，语，舅舅也认真的回答和讲解。小夜暗自高兴啊，今天完成目标了，天气凉爽，一会儿和大牛，小东，柱子他们玩去，小夜心思早不在这里了。“小夜啊，坐下，交代几句，我说你听”“不用，舅舅你说，我站着就可以”小夜舅舅看看他，喝了口茶，拿了一本书，说道“你们佳家，是这片大陆上赫赫有名的修真家族，特别是家族绝学幻缘灵犀指，更是神鬼莫测，受万人敬仰，不知道有多少人想拜入你们佳家修行，而你有灵根，也可修仙”什么？小夜不冷静了，他猛抬头，张大嘴巴，直勾勾的看着舅舅。“嘿嘿，舅舅也是修真者，金丹修士，人称青焰散人，”“舅，您要教我修仙？我将来也能成为神仙吗？”小夜激动的打断了舅舅的话。小夜的舅舅默默地看了他一会儿，沉思了一下，说道“夜儿啊，我平时咋教你的，处乱不惊，多看，多听，少说话，多做事，你看看你，平时称呼我是你，一听我是修士，想让我教你，你就称呼您了，小毛病坏大事啊，”“对不起，我太兴奋了！”他低头道。“我是你亲舅舅，不怪你，下面，我说的话，你听着，懂不懂，我不管，”唉！小夜心里暗暗叹气，舅舅是个好舅舅，就是太严厉，从不笑，从不生气，脸上啥时候都无表情，眼睛里还透着威严，就是拿板子打自己手心的时候，也是面无表情。母亲没见过，父亲没印象，舅舅管吃管喝，管穿管住，顾佣人、家丁伺候自己，也不容易啊…青焰散人默默的喝茶，思考了一下继续说道“我们所处的地方叫裂尘大陆，这片大陆亿万千里，凡人几代都走不到尽头，大修士从东到西，从南到北，空中飞行也要上百年，大陆上有4大顶级势力，你们佳家算是其一，你家里的孩童到了9岁就要测灵根，进祠堂，告鉴祖宗，学习百艺，传承血脉，你都12岁了啊，也没人来接你，是不是把你忘记了，当年接你时，我和你父有约定，你9岁生日那天，他就派人来找我。呵呵，他忘记了吧，也对，你父没灵根，一介草民，家族群里也说不上话，你母亲是修士，但是回宗门闭关修炼去了，这么多年了也没有出关，唉！”青焰散人看了看小夜，见他没有插话，心道，这孩子还能沉住气，不错！“我不会传你功法，你家里面的法门更厉害，但是不知他们啥时候接你，为了不耽误你修行，这里有一本《太上冲灵决》，不是什么绝学，店铺里都有卖的，很普通，在我们这片大陆上，每个散修启蒙功法就是它，你拿去看看，先不要练，多看几遍，多思考，看完后我听听你的解见，另外，这本《修真界杂记》你也拿去，闲暇时看看解解闷吧，去吧！”“这就完了”心里嘀咕一声，小夜知道舅舅不喜欢繁琐，行礼告退。
content_en: The small village is still that small village. The river flows quietly, the white clouds float quietly, and the grass grows quietly. Therefore, the small village is still that quiet small village. What changes everything in Jingjing is this group of carefree country children.Jia Xiaoye was playing in the river with a large group of children. The children were all about ten years old, catching fish and shrimps, and playing in the mud and water.Everyone was playing happily, the sun was so hot that the flowers and grass bowed their heads, and the cats and dogs were so hot... I don’t know where they ran.The water is so cold!So comfortable!It’s so enjoyable!In the eyes of children, isn't this how this day should look?Need to express your feelings?On the shore, there was a middle-aged man in linen clothes. He looked at the children coldly. After a while, he sighed softly, and disappeared in a flash.An hour later, the children got tired and climbed up to the shore one by one, each going back to his own home to find his mother... Jia Xiaoye is 12 years old, not too young... Neither of his parents are from this village.Mother?He had never seen him before, only in pictures, and he didn't look like a country person.As for my father, I met him before I was 6 years old, but I have no impression of him!Now I know that they are rich and wealthy people in big cities.Xiaoye was brought to this small village by her uncle when she was more than 6 years old. Six years have passed now, so Jia Xiaoye is 12 years old... Xiaoye walked quietly to her home. As soon as she entered the courtyard gate, she saw her uncle under the eaves. It was the middle-aged Mai Yi who was by the river just now."You are going to do your homework now. After dinner, come to my uncle's study." "Oh." Jia Xiaoye entered her room, put down pens, ink, paper and inkstones. She first practiced three pages of regular calligraphy and drew a few pictures before picking up the book and reciting and reading carefully.The books are all common children's enlightenment courses, focusing on the understanding of each word. This is Uncle Xiaoye's main requirement.Recognize, practice, and understand the Chinese characters, as well as the meaning of each sentence and my own opinions. My uncle will test it later, and I must not be careless.An hour later, Xiaoye changed another book - "The True Explanation of the Encyclopedia of Herbal Medicine". This book was required by her uncle to be memorized by rote and not to be understood.I remember that a few months ago, he read the "Inscription of Gold and Stone", and his uncle also asked him to do the same. Xiaoye didn't pay attention. During the examination, he confused Tianyin Stone and Hongyin Stone. As a result, his palms were swollen for three days, which caused him terrible pain. Alas!Not allowed to eat... At dusk, the servant girl brought the food and walked out of the door quietly. Xiaoye chewed her dinner slowly, washed her hands, tidied her clothes, and went out.I walked through the simple cobblestone path, crossed the wing, and came to my uncle's study. I took a breath and was about to lock the door. "Come in," my uncle said. Xiao Ye came in and said hello, and then came the study of learning. Fortunately, my uncle's questions were not difficult today, and Xiao Ye answered them one by one. After that, there were a few words, words, and expressions that I didn't understand, and my uncle also answered and explained them seriously.Xiaoye is secretly happy. She has achieved her goal today. The weather is cool. She will go play with Daniel, Xiaodong, and Zhuzhu later. Xiaoye's mind is no longer here."Xiaoye, sit down and tell me a few words. I say you listen." "No, uncle, just say it, I can just stand." Uncle Xiaoye looked at him, took a sip of tea, took a book, and said, "Your Jiajia is a famous cultivation family on this continent, especially the family's unique skill, Illusion Fate Lingxi Finger.Xiaoye lost his composure. He raised his head suddenly, opened his mouth wide, and looked directly at his uncle."Hehe, my uncle is also a cultivator, a golden elixir monk, known as Qingyan Sanren." "Uncle, you want to teach me how to cultivate immortality? Can I become an immortal in the future?" Xiao Ye interrupted her uncle excitedly.Xiao Ye's uncle looked at him silently for a while, pondered for a moment, and said, "Ye'er, how do I teach you? You should not be alarmed in any situation. Look more, listen more, talk less, and do more. Look at you. You usually call me "you". When you hear that I am a monk and you want me to teach you, you call me "you." "It's a small problem that can lead to big things." "I'm sorry, I'm too excited!" He lowered his head."I am your biological uncle. I don't blame you. Now, listen to what I say. I don't care whether you understand it or not." Alas!Xiao Ye sighed secretly in her heart. Her uncle was a good uncle, but he was too strict. He never smiled or got angry. His face was expressionless at all times, and his eyes still showed majesty. Even when he hit his palm with a board, his face was expressionless.My mother has never seen her, my father has no impression. My uncle is in charge of food, drink, clothing, and housing. It is not easy to take care of the servants and servants... Qingyan Sanren drank tea in silence, thought for a moment and continued, "The place we are in is called the Rift Continent. This continent has hundreds of millions of people."Here, mortals will never reach the end of the world for several generations. It takes hundreds of years for a great monk to fly in the air from east to west, from south to north. There are four top powers on the continent, and your Jiajia family is one of them. When the children in your family reach the age of 9, they must have their spiritual roots tested, enter the ancestral hall, and report to their ancestors.Learn all kinds of arts and inherit the bloodline. You are already 12 years old, and no one has come to pick you up. Have you forgotten? When I picked you up, your father and I made an agreement. On your 9th birthday, he would send someone to find me.Haha, he must have forgotten, that’s right, your father has no spiritual roots., a commoner, and even the family group can't talk about it. Your mother is a monk, but she went back to the sect to practice in seclusion, and she has not left seclusion for so many years.Alas!" Qingyan Sanren looked at Xiaoye and saw that he didn't interrupt. He thought to himself, this child can still keep his temper, good!"I won't teach you the techniques. The techniques in your family are more powerful, but I don't know when they will pick you up. In order not to delay your practice, here is a copy of "Tai Shang Chong Ling Jue". It is not a special skill. It is sold in stores. It is very common. In our continent, this is the enlightenment technique for every casual practitioner."Take it and read it. Don't practice it yet. Read it a few times and think more. After reading it, I will listen to your opinions. In addition, you can also take this "Miscellaneous Notes on the World of Cultivation" and read it to relieve your boredom in your spare time. Go!""That's it." Xiaoye muttered in her heart, knowing that her uncle didn't like tedious things, so she bowed and left.
